This reveals that the majority of behavioral and opinion simulation tasks will rapidly improve with scale, particularly when they involve populations that are well-represented in English web corpora. Longitudinal forecasting and underrepresented opinions scale more slowly, especially when they are less correlated with general knowledge and reasoning benchmarks like MMLU. In behavior simulation, scaling fails to improve model calibration with human cognitive biases like risk aversion, as well as human heuristics like learning correlated rewards from related tasks. On these tasks, even fine-tuned models fail to noticeably scale up performance from 0.5B to 8B parameters. Taken together, we conclude that scale will improve social simulations in most settings, but outliers exist, and improvements will be less reliable in low-resource domains.

AI.tldr: 本文通过缩放定律研究LLM在社交模拟中的保真度，发现计算规模提升能显著改善多数场景下的模拟效果，但在纵向预测、低资源群体以及模拟人类认知偏差（如风险规避）等任务上，缩放效果有限甚至失效。
AI.motivation: LLM社交模拟作为一种有前景的研究方法，其保真度尚不足以被广泛采用。作者想探究当前语言模型的缩放范式能否弥合这一差距，还是说模拟保真度与通用能力是正交的、需要额外研究投入。
AI.method: 使用缩放定律，在三个子领域（意见建模、行为模拟、纵向预测）中，对85个基于Qwen3架构、DCLM语料预训练的Transformer LLM（计算预算10^18~10^20 FLOPs）以及35个更大规模的开源模型（最高70B参数）进行系统评估，从损失值预测下游精度。
AI.result: 多数行为与意见模拟任务随规模提升快速改进，尤其在英语语料覆盖良好的群体中。纵向预测和低资源群体意见模拟的缩放速度较慢，且与MMLU等通用基准的相关性较低。在行为模拟中，缩放未能改善模型在人类认知偏差（如风险规避）和学习相关任务奖励等启发式上的校准能力，即使从0.5B扩展到8B参数，性能也无显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 规模提升在大多数社交模拟场景中有效，但存在异常值，且在低资源领域中的改进不可靠。部分任务（如模拟人类认知偏差）需要超越简单缩放的专门研究。

title: A-TMA: Decoupling State-Aware Memory Failures in Long-Term Agent Memory
summary: Long term memory lets LLM agents act as persistent assistants, but user facts change. A useful memory system must know what is true now, what used to be true, and what changed. We study \emph{ghost memory}, a state coordination failure in which old, current, and transition facts coexist in the memory bank, remain mixed during retrieval, and mislead the answer model. We argue that memory systems should be understood and optimized from three levels: bank maintenance, retrieval, and answer time resolution. We propose ATMA, a state aware overlay for existing memory systems. ATMA keeps superseded and transition records in the bank, builds evidence packets for the query's requested state view, and exposes current, historical, and transition labels to QA. We further call for decoupled evaluation of bank, retrieval, and answer level failures, since final QA accuracy can hide where ghost memory occurs. To make this failure measurable, we build LTP (LoCoMo Temporal Plus), a conflict heavy benchmark for ghost memory, and evaluate on LoCoMo for long conversation generalization. On LTP, Graphiti+ATMA improves conflict accuracy by 0.240 absolute over Graphiti. On LoCoMo, Graphiti+ATMA raises temporal F1 from 0.0295 to 0.1705. The gains are host dependent, but they indicate that explicit state roles can reduce memory failures hidden by final QA accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATMA，一种面向LLM代理记忆系统的状态感知覆盖层，用于解决记忆库中旧事实、当前事实和过渡事实共存导致的"幽灵记忆"问题，在冲突检测和时序F1上显著提升。
AI.motivation: LLM代理作为持久助手需要记忆系统，但用户事实会随时间变化。现有记忆系统存在"幽灵记忆"（ghost memory）——旧、当前和过渡事实在记忆库中混合共存，检索时混淆，误导答案模型，导致状态协调失败。
AI.method: 提出ATMA（状态感知覆盖层），在三个层面优化记忆系统：1）记忆库维护层：保留被取代的记录和过渡记录；2）检索层：为查询请求的状态视图构建证据包；3）答案层：暴露当前、历史和过渡标签给QA。同时提出LTP基准数据集用于评估幽灵记忆。
AI.result: 在LTP上，Graphiti+ATMA相比Graphiti冲突准确率提升0.240；在LoCoMo上，时序F1从0.0295提升至0.1705。
AI.conclusion: 显式状态角色可以降低被最终QA准确率掩盖的记忆失败，但增益依赖于宿主记忆系统。呼吁对记忆系统的库维护、检索和答案层进行解耦评估。

title: SAB-LVLM: Significance-Aware Binarization for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in multimodal understanding, yet their enormous parameter scale and cross-modal computation incur substantial memory and latency overhead, severely limiting real-world deployment on resource-constrained devices. Binarization offers an attractive solution by drastically reducing storage and computational costs. However, existing binarization methods neglect the varying importance of weights across different layers and modalities. This causes parameters irrelevant to downstream tasks to be unnecessarily retained, whereas modality-critical weights may not be adequately optimized, resulting in significant performance degradation. To address these challenges, we develop a novel \underline{S}ignificance-\underline{A}ware \underline{B}inarization for \underline{L}arge \underline{V}ision-\underline{L}anguage \underline{M}odels (SAB-LVLM). Specifically, after constructing Hessian matrices for textual and visual inputs, we propose a spatial significance map to distinguish full-precision weights activated under a single modality from those activated across modalities. We then devise a modality-guided integration strategy to obtain the significance-aware binarization map, which measures weight significance across layers and modalities. Subsequently, this binarization map is incorporated into the binarization objective as an error reweighting term, and binarization fitting is performed through an alternating significance-weighted update scheme. Extensive experiments illustrate the superiority of our SAB-LVLM over existing binary PTQ methods under an approximately 1-bit compression constraint. Our code is accessible at https://github.com/LyuQi127/SAB_LVLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SAB-LVLM的显著性感知二值化方法，通过构建海森矩阵和空间显著性图来区分不同模态和层级的权重重要性，并在二值化目标中引入误差重新加权项，实现约1比特压缩下的高性能LVLM量化。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM参数量巨大，在资源受限设备上部署困难；而现有二值化方法忽略了不同层和不同模态下权重的重要性差异，导致与下游任务无关的参数被不必要保留，而模态关键权重未充分优化，造成性能显著下降。
AI.method: 1) 为文本和视觉输入构建海森矩阵；2) 提出空间显著性图来区分单模态激活权重与跨模态激活权重；3) 设计模态引导的整合策略得到显著性感知的二值化图；4) 将该图作为误差重新加权项融入二值化目标；5) 通过交替显著性加权更新方案进行二值化拟合。
AI.result: 在约1比特压缩约束下，SAB-LVLM在多项实验上优于现有的二值化PTQ方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显著性感知的二值化策略，能够有效提升LVLM在极低比特压缩下的性能，为资源受限设备上的部署提供了可行方案。

title: Audio-Based Understanding of Audiobook Narration Appeal
summary: Narration is central to the audiobook listening experience, shaping how listeners engage with and understand the content. This work explores how narration qualities shape an audiobook's appeal, noting that their effects can vary by genre, title, and audience. We extract vocal and acoustic features (e.g., tone, pace, loudness) from LibriVox using pre-trained audio models and analyse their relationship with consumption data (specifically, view-rate) and their interplay with genre and title. Despite limited consumption data, we find that acoustic information alone has a robust association with appeal, even after accounting for title effects. We further validate these findings using more nuanced proprietary engagement metrics. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic computational study linking narration qualities, genre, title, and audiobook consumption, highlighting the potential of data-driven insights to improve audiobook personalisation and narrator casting.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地通过计算分析，研究旁白质量（如语调、节奏、响度等声学特征）与有声书消费数据（如观看率）之间的关系，发现声学信息本身与有声书吸引力有显著关联，且这一效应独立于标题和类型的影响。
AI.motivation: 旁白是影响有声书听众体验和内容理解的关键因素，但旁白质量如何影响有声书的吸引力（尤其是在不同类型和标题下的差异）缺乏系统性计算研究。
AI.method: 从LibriVox中提取语调和节奏等声学特征，使用预训练音频模型分析其与消费数据（观看率）的关系，并考虑类型和标题的交互效应；同时使用更细粒度的专有参与度指标进行验证。
AI.result: 声学信息（旁白质量）与有声书吸引力有稳健关联，即使控制标题效应后仍然显著；这些发现在更细粒度的参与度指标上也得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个将旁白质量、类型、标题与有声书消费联系起来的系统性计算研究，展示了数据驱动方法在有声书个性化和旁白选角方面的潜力。

title: Atomic Task Graph: A Unified Framework for Agentic Planning and Execution
summary: LLM-based agents have shown strong potential for solving complex multi-step tasks, yet existing performance improvements often rely on either scaling to larger backbone models or task-specific fine-tuning. The former incurs substantial computational costs, while the latter typically generalizes poorly across different tasks. Although prompt-based control is training-free and broadly applicable, existing methods still leave input-output dependencies between subtasks implicit in textual trajectories, making verified intermediate results difficult to reuse. To address these limitations, we propose Atomic Task Graph (ATG), a unified control framework for planning and execution. Specifically, ATG maintains an explicit graph to expose dependencies and support reuse. During planning, it recursively decomposes a high-level task into subtasks, forming a sequence of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) whose evolution can be traced. During execution, the dependencies exposed by ATG allow independent branches to be executed in parallel, thereby improving execution efficiency. When failures are detected, ATG leverages the graph evolution history to localize the error source and repair only the affected region, preserving validated regions unchanged. Experiments show that ATG consistently outperforms strong baselines in success rate and execution efficiency across three interactive benchmarks using only 7B-8B backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出原子任务图(ATG)框架，通过显式图结构进行任务分解与执行，实现并行执行、错误定位与修复，在7B-8B小模型上超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM agent方法要么依赖大模型带来高计算成本，要么依赖任务微调导致泛化差；基于提示的方法虽免训练但隐式依赖难以复用中间结果。
AI.method: 构建显式有向无环图(DAG)结构，递归分解高层任务为子任务；执行时利用依赖关系并行执行独立分支；检测到错误时通过图演化历史定位错误源并仅修复受影响区域。
AI.result: 在三个交互式基准测试中，仅使用7B-8B参数量的模型，ATG在成功率和执行效率上一致超越强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ATG框架通过显式图结构实现训练自由、泛化良好且高效的多步骤任务规划与执行，证明小模型也能通过合理的结构设计达到优异性能。

title: Diversity-aware View Partitioning for Scalable VGGT
summary: Geometry transformers such as VGGT achieve strong performance by jointly reasoning over multiple views with global attention. However, scaling them to large view collections remains challenging due to the quadratic cost of attention. Moreover, our empirical analysis reveals that the reconstruction quality in VGGT is sensitive to the distribution of viewpoints. Simply increasing the number of views without sufficient viewpoint diversity can even degrade performance, as redundant views introduce highly similar tokens that dilute informative geometric signals in the attention mechanism. Motivated by this observation, we propose a training-free and plug-and-play VGGT inference framework that organizes views into diversity-aware balanced chunks. The chunks are constructed through combinatorial graph partitioning over visual dissimilarity and spatial dispersion. This view organization allows the transformer to focus attention on geometrically informative views while reducing redundant attention interactions. To estimate spatial dispersion without full pose estimation, we approximate spatial relationships via a soft pose propagation strategy based on visual similarity from a small set of seed frames. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved performance in camera pose estimation, multi-view depth prediction, and 3D reconstruction while reducing memory usage and inference latency. Our framework also complements existing VGGT variants, enabling scalable multi-view reconstruction without sacrificing geometric fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的VGGT推理框架，通过多样性感知的平衡分块组织视图，减少冗余注意力交互，提升多视图3D重建性能并降低内存和延迟。
AI.motivation: VGGT等几何变换器在处理大量视图时存在注意力计算成本高的问题，且冗余视图会稀释有效几何信号，降低重建质量。
AI.method: 基于视觉不相似性和空间分散性的组合图划分，构建多样性感知的平衡视图分块；通过基于视觉相似性的软姿态传播策略近似空间关系。
AI.result: 在相机姿态估计、多视图深度预测和3D重建任务上取得性能提升，同时降低内存使用和推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 该训练无关、即插即用的框架可有效扩展VGGT到大规模视图集合，并兼容现有VGGT变体。

title: Visually Grounded Self-Reflection for Vision-Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large vision-language models can reason over multimodal inputs by generating textual chains of thought (CoT). A key capability exhibited in CoT reasoning is self-reflection: revisiting earlier decisions and correcting previous errors. However, existing LVLMs often fail to properly attend to visual inputs during reflection, limiting their ability to translate feedback into grounded corrections, especially for out-of-distribution images. To address this issue, we propose a novel reinforcement learning training framework VRRL, with two components explicitly designed to elicit visually grounded self-reflection. First, we randomly mask trajectory prefixes during training to emphasize recovery from incorrect intermediate predictions rather than making early mistakes. Second, we introduce buffered roll-ins from an experience replay buffer to expose the model to diverse failure states that it must learn to correct. We evaluate our approach on visual grounding tasks involving tables and charts, as well as spatial navigation benchmarks. While off-the-shelf and conventionally fine-tuned models degrade substantially under distribution shift, our method substantially improves average out-of-distribution accuracy over standard RL and reflection-oriented fine-tuning baselines by using self-reflection effectively.

AI.tldr: 提出VRRL框架，通过强化学习训练大视觉语言模型进行视觉接地自反思，提升分布外场景的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM在反思过程中未能正确关注视觉输入，导致基于反馈的修正缺乏视觉接地能力，尤其在分布外图像上表现不佳。
AI.method: VRRL框架包含两个组件：1) 随机遮蔽轨迹前缀，迫使模型从中期错误中恢复；2) 引入经验回放缓冲区的滚动插入，暴露模型于多样的失败状态。
AI.result: 在表格、图表视觉接地和空间导航任务上，VRRL在分布外准确性上显著优于现成模型、标准RL和面向反思的微调基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过有效利用自反思，VRRL能够提升模型在分布偏移下的视觉接地修正能力。

title: OntoLearner: A Modular Python Library for Ontology Learning with Large Language Models
comment: 30 pages. Under review at Nature Communications. This version is reformatted with a different section structure; content is unchanged
summary: Ontology learning (OL) aims to automatically construct structured knowledge models from text, yet progress remains fragmented across methods, domains, and evaluation practices. Despite decades of research, OL lacks a shared infrastructure for systematic evaluation and ontology access. This absence has hindered progress and fragmented research, leaving the central challenges of OL largely unaddressed. We introduce OntoLearner, a modular, cross-domain, and first-of-its-kind framework that unifies ontology access, large language model (LLM)-driven learning pipelines, and standardized benchmarking. OntoLearner releases 180 machine-readable ontologies spanning 22 domains and provides pipeline-ready datasets with train/dev/test splits for three core OL tasks: term typing, taxonomy discovery, and non-taxonomic relation extraction. Using this infrastructure, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of OL, evaluating 22 retrieval models and 12 LLMs across domains and tasks. The results converge on a finding that reframes the central challenge of OL: failure modes scale with ontological complexity rather than model size or architectural sophistication. The primary bottleneck is not model capability, but a structural mismatch between how models encode knowledge and how ontologies organize it. These findings establish that effective OL is reachable through the cross-domain, multi-task benchmarking enabled by OntoLearner. OntoLearner is open-source (MIT license) at https://github.com/sciknoworg/OntoLearner/.

AI.tldr: OntoLearner是一个统一的跨领域本体学习框架，集成了本体访问、LLM驱动的学习管道和标准化基准测试，通过大规模实验发现本体学习的核心瓶颈是模型知识编码与本体组织结构之间的结构性不匹配，而非模型能力本身。
AI.motivation: 本体学习研究长期碎片化，缺乏统一的系统评估和本体访问基础设施，阻碍了领域进步。
AI.method: 构建OntoLearner框架，整合180个机器可读本体（覆盖22个领域），提供三个核心OL任务（术语分类、 taxonomy发现、非分类关系提取）的管道就绪数据集，并评估22个检索模型和12个LLM。
AI.result: 本体学习的失败模式与本体的复杂性（而非模型规模或架构）相关；核心瓶颈是模型知识编码与本体组织结构之间的结构性不匹配。
AI.conclusion: 有效的本体学习可以通过跨领域、多任务的基准测试实现，OntoLearner为此提供了基础设施。

title: Reasoning LLM Improves Speaker Recognition in Long-form TV Dramas
summary: Long-form TV dramas present a formidable challenge for comprehensive video understanding, where deciphering complex storyline often relies on \textbf{speaker recognition}, the task of accurately attributing each spoken utterance to its respective character. In this paper, we advance this field through two primary contributions. (1) We introduce \textbf{DramaSR-532K}, a large-scale benchmark comprising 532K annotated dialogue lines across more than 900 unique characters, necessitating the integration of auditory, linguistic, and visual cues for speaker recognition. (2) We propose \textbf{DramaSR-LRM}, a robust approach built upon a large reasoning model (LRM). DramaSR-LRM is designed to autonomously aggregate contextual evidence via multimodal tool-use, synthesizing diverse inputs to achieve high-fidelity attribution. Experimental results demonstrate that DramaSR-LRM significantly outperforms existing baselines, particularly on short utterances where acoustic biometrics are inherently unreliable. \textit{All the data and code will be made publicly available at the project page: https://www.github.com/198808xc/DramaSR-LRM.}

AI.tldr: 本文针对长剧视频理解中的说话人识别任务，提出了大规模基准数据集DramaSR-532K（含53.2万标注对话行、900+角色）和基于大推理模型的DramaSR-LRM方法，该方法通过多模态工具自主聚合证据，在短 utterance 场景下显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 长剧视频理解面临挑战，准确识别每句台词的说话人是理解复杂故事情节的关键，现有方法在短 utterance 等场景下效果不佳。
AI.method: (1) 构建DramaSR-532K大规模基准数据集；(2) 提出DramaSR-LRM方法，基于大推理模型，通过多模态工具使用自主聚合上下文证据，融合听觉、语言和视觉线索进行高保真说话人归因。
AI.result: DramaSR-LRM显著优于现有基线，尤其在声学生物特征不可靠的短 utterance 场景下表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 数据与代码将开源，为长剧说话人识别任务提供新的基准与方法。

title: Multimodal Knowledge Edit-Scoped Generalization for Online Recursive MLLM Editing
summary: Online multimodal knowledge editing requires injecting a continual stream of visual-textual corrections into multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with bounded overhead and minimal disruption to unrelated behaviors. Existing editors mainly emphasize edit reliability and long-horizon stability, but rarely control the semantic boundary of each edit. Our pilot analyses of post-edit behaviors and internal neuronal activities reveal a scope gap behind reliable edits: instance-level success neither guarantees transfer to valid cross-modal variants nor prevents leakage to unrelated inputs, while edit-related cross-modal responses concentrate in deeper semantic layers. Therefore, we formulate Edit-Scoped Generalization, reframing online MLLM editing from merely correcting an instance to controlling the propagation boundary of each edit. To this end, we propose ScopeEdit, a scope-aware online editor that decomposes each update into a modality-local absorption branch and an evidence-gated shared generalization branch. The local branch supports stable edit absorption, whereas the shared branch enables cross-modal propagation only when visual and textual evidence are sufficiently aligned. Both branches perform scope-separated write geometries in orthogonal low-rank spaces and maintain branch-wise preconditioners via Sherman--Morrison recursions, yielding constant per-edit overhead. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks, long-horizon edit streams, MLLM backbones, real-world VLKEB scenarios, and complex vision-language architectures show that ScopeEdit consistently improves the trade-off between in-scope cross-modal transfer and out-of-scope locality, while preserving edit reliability, stability and online efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/lab-klc/ScopeEdit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScopeEdit，一种范围感知的在线多模态大模型编辑方法，通过将编辑分解为模态局部吸收分支和证据门控共享泛化分支，在正交低秩空间中实现范围分离写入，从而在保证编辑可靠性的同时，有效控制编辑的语义传播边界，提升跨模态迁移与无关样本隔离的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有在线多模态知识编辑方法主要关注编辑可靠性和长期稳定性，但忽视了每个编辑的语义边界控制。作者发现编辑存在"范围鸿沟"：实例级编辑成功并不能保证有效跨模态变体迁移，也无法防止向无关输入的泄漏。
AI.method: 提出ScopeEdit，包含两个分支：1) 模态局部吸收分支，支持稳定的编辑吸收；2) 证据门控共享泛化分支，仅在视觉和文本证据充分对齐时才允许跨模态传播。两个分支在正交低秩空间中进行范围分离写入，通过Sherman-Morrison递归维护分支级预条件子，实现恒定每编辑开销。
AI.result: 在多种基准、长时序编辑流、不同MLLM骨干、真实VLKEB场景以及复杂视觉-语言架构上，ScopeEdit一致提升了范围内跨模态迁移与范围外隔离的权衡，同时保持了编辑可靠性、稳定性和在线效率。
AI.conclusion: 本文重新定义了在线MLLM编辑的目标，从仅纠正实例转变为控制每个编辑的传播边界，ScopeEdit为此提供了有效的解决方案。

title: LACUNA: A Testbed for Evaluating Localization Precision for LLM Unlearning
summary: LLMs memorize sensitive training data, including personally identifiable information (PII), creating a pressing need for reliable post hoc removal methods. Unlearning has emerged as a promising solution, with state-of-the-art(SOTA) methods often following a localize-first, unlearn-second paradigm that targets specific model parameters. However, existing benchmarks evaluate unlearning solely at the output level, leaving open the question of whether unlearning truly erases knowledge from a model's parameters or merely obfuscates it, a concern reinforced by the success of resurfacing attacks. To bridge this gap, we introduce LACUNA: the first unlearning testbed with ground-truth parameter-level localization. LACUNA injects PII of synthetic individuals into predefined parameters of 1B and 7B OLMo-based models via masked continual pretraining, enabling direct evaluation of whether unlearning targets the weights responsible for knowledge storage. We use LACUNA to benchmark current SOTA unlearning methods and find that, despite strong output-level performance, existing methods are highly imprecise and susceptible to resurfacing attacks. We further show that when localization is successful, even a simple gradient-based unlearning method achieves strong erasure and robustness to resurfacing attacks, highlighting the importance of precise unlearning. We release LACUNA to complement behavioral evaluations and drive further advances in robust, localization-based unlearning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了LACUNA，首个具有参数级ground-truth定位的机器遗忘测试平台，通过向模型预定义参数注入合成PII来评估遗忘方法是否真正擦除知识而非掩盖它。实验表明现有SOTA方法虽然输出层面表现好，但参数层面不精确且易受重新浮现攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有遗忘方法仅在输出层面评估，无法判断是否真正从模型参数中擦除知识还是仅仅掩盖，这被重新浮现攻击的成功所证实。
AI.method: LACUNA通过掩码连续预训练将合成个体的PII注入到1B和7B OLMo模型的预定义参数中，提供参数层面的ground-truth定位，用于直接评估遗忘方法是否针对存储知识的权重。
AI.result: 现有SOTA遗忘方法在输出层面表现良好，但在参数层面高度不精确，且容易受到重新浮现攻击；而当定位成功时，即使是简单的基于梯度的遗忘方法也能实现强擦除和对重新浮现攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 精确的参数定位对于实现鲁棒的机器遗忘至关重要，LACUNA可作为行为评估的补充，推动基于定位的遗忘方法进一步发展。

title: Episodic-to-Semantic Consolidation Without Identity Drift
summary: Long-running adaptive intelligent agents face a structural tension between knowledge consolidation and information integrity. Memory consolidation is conventionally treated as an agent-changing operation: a model is fine-tuned, a prompt rewritten, a policy distilled, or a reflection appended to the context that governs future behaviour. In regulated autonomic deployment this is a liability because the agent operates under commitments and audit contracts that bind to a specific, cryptographically certified identity. We propose to treat consolidation not as a mutation of the planner or the identity manifest, but as a deterministic function f: M^ep -> M^sem over episodic memory whose output is a separately addressable semantic knowledge layer; the identity hash does not read M^sem, so consolidation updates knowledge without changing the agent's certified identity. We give a formal account of the agent representation, prove identity invariance through a structural lemma on the manifest's hash-input set, specify a deterministic aggregation algorithm whose outputs are auditable database rows with explicit confidence and supporting-event provenance, and validate the construction with synthetic experiments demonstrating per-field correctness, byte-equal identity across consolidation passes, and a mean 79.82% reduction in unproductive planner attempts (95% BCa CI [78.02%, 81.49%] across 10 seeds) against a calibrated Bayesian-shrunk baseline. The construction is a knowledge-update discipline for autonomic agents in which lessons accumulate as queryable facts while the agent's certified identity remains byte-equal across its operational lifetime, with an embodied service agent as the running case study.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将记忆巩固与智能体身份解耦的方法，通过确定性函数将情节记忆映射为语义知识层，确保智能体在更新知识时其加密认证身份保持不变。
AI.motivation: 传统记忆巩固会改变智能体自身（如微调模型、重写提示），这在受监管的自律部署中会破坏智能体基于加密认证身份的审计契约与承诺约束。
AI.method: 定义确定性函数 f: M^ep → M^sem，将情节记忆映射为独立可寻址的语义知识层；身份哈希不读取 M^sem，从而知识更新不影响认证身份；给出形式化证明与确定性的聚合算法。
AI.result: 字段级正确性验证通过；多次巩固后身份字节一致；平均减少79.82%的无效规划尝试（95% BCa CI [78.02%, 81.49%]）。
AI.conclusion: 该构造为自主智能体提供了一种知识更新规范：经验累积为可查询事实，而智能体的加密认证身份在其全生命周期内保持字节级不变。

title: SFKD: Spatial--Frequency Joint-Aware Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation via Multi-Level Wavelet Spectral Interaction
summary: Most existing knowledge distillation methods focus on homogeneous models (e.g., CNN-to-CNN), thereby overlooking the flexibility and potential of knowledge transfer across heterogeneous models. Due to intrinsic inductive bias discrepancies between heterogeneous models that cause spatial distribution inconsistencies, prior heterogeneous distillation methods often weaken or discard spatial information in heterogeneous representations. However, the spatial information in representations often encodes transferable global structural semantics as well as architecture-specific local details, and therefore should not be directly ignored. To better leverage the spatial information encoded in heterogeneous representations, we propose a Spatial-Frequency Joint-Aware Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation framework (SFKD). By leveraging the complementary properties of wavelet transform spatial locality and Fourier representations in characterizing global energy distributions, we first apply multi-level discrete wavelet transform to explicitly decouple spatial information. The resulting wavelet sub-bands are further refined by a dual-stream dual-stage refinement module, and finally combined with a Gaussian-filtered frequency loss to selectively capture informative global information. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets under both homogeneous and heterogeneous models demonstrate the superiority of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SFKD框架，通过小波变换和傅里叶表示联合建模，在异构知识蒸馏中有效保留并利用空间信息，显著提升异构模型间的知识迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 现有异构知识蒸馏方法因模型间归纳偏差导致空间分布不一致，往往削弱或丢弃空间信息，但空间信息包含可迁移的全局结构语义和架构特定的局部细节，不应被忽视。
AI.method: 利用小波变换的空间局部性和傅里叶表示的全局能量分布特性，先对空间信息进行多级离散小波变换显式解耦，再通过双流双阶段精化模块处理小波子带，最后结合高斯滤波频率损失选择性捕获全局信息。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，同构和异构模型下的实验均证明了该方法优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SFKD框架有效解决了异构知识蒸馏中空间信息丢失的问题，为异构模型间的知识迁移提供了新的有效途径。

title: Traceable Fault Diagnosis for Battery Energy Storage Systems via Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Agent O&M Assistant
summary: Large-scale battery energy storage systems (BESSs) require O&M decisions that combine alarms, cell-level measurements, device topology, diagnostic tables, historical cases, and maintenance documents. Monitoring platforms can flag threshold violations, but they often cannot explain whether voltage inconsistency, resistance drift, short-circuit risk, capacity divergence, or thermal abnormality needs intervention. This digest presents a traceable BESS fault-diagnosis assistant that uses retrieval-augmented multi-agent reasoning to connect operational data, domain knowledge, visual evidence, and report generation. Reliability is improved through BESS-specific task routing, schema-constrained natural-language database access, hybrid text-image retrieval, and evidence-based answer synthesis. Preliminary internal evaluation is reported for routing, database access, and diagnostic reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于检索增强多智能体推理的BESS故障诊断助手，通过任务路由、自然语言数据库访问、混合文本-图像检索和证据合成，提升运维决策的可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 大规模BESS需要综合多种数据源进行运维决策，但现有监控平台只能检测阈值违规，无法解释电压不一致、电阻漂移、短路风险、容量差异或热异常等故障的根本原因。
AI.method: 采用检索增强多智能体推理框架，包含BESS专用任务路由、模式约束的自然语言数据库访问、混合文本-图像检索以及基于证据的答案合成。
AI.result: 在路由、数据库访问和诊断推理三个环节进行了初步内部评估。
AI.conclusion: 该诊断助手通过连接运行数据、领域知识、视觉证据和报告生成，提升了BESS故障诊断的可追溯性和可靠性。

title: InduceKV: Fixed-Footprint Continual Adaptation of Multimodal LLMs via Inducing KV Memories
summary: Multimodal large language models must adapt to evolving tasks and domains, yet continual improvement under bounded deployment footprint remains difficult because repeated parameter updates or growing replay stores can accumulate adaptation state over time. We study fixed-footprint continual adaptation: the deployed adaptation state is kept under a fixed memory budget, while the backbone model is left unchanged and task-specific updates are externalized. We propose InduceKV, a retrieval-based method that stores each selected training prefix as an attention-ready memory entry, consisting of a frozen retrieval key and compact layerwise key--value (KV) payloads that can be appended to the model's self-attention cache. Under a strict memory budget, InduceKV constructs a compact inducing set through bilevel selection: a lightweight calibration is fit for retrieval, while the selected memory balances current-task likelihood, anchor-based retention, and coverage in the frozen retrieval space. Across task-incremental instruction tuning, continual VQA, domain-incremental adaptation, and lifelong multimodal instruction tuning, InduceKV consistently improves over PEFT, MoE, replay, and prompt-retrieval baselines under matched memory budgets. We further report backbone-matched, stage-1 CoIN, compute-matched, and scalability diagnostics, showing that the gains are not due to a stronger backbone, replay alone, or an unbounded candidate pool.

AI.tldr: 提出InduceKV方法，通过检索和紧凑的记忆存储，在固定内存预算下实现多模态大语言模型的持续适应，无需更新骨干模型。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型需要持续适应新任务，但传统方法（参数更新或重放存储）会积累过多适应状态，难以在固定部署预算下进行持续改进。
AI.method: InduceKV采用检索式方法，将选中的训练前缀存储为注意力就绪的记忆条目（包含冻结检索键和紧凑的逐层KV载荷），通过双层选择构建紧凑诱导集，平衡当前任务似然、锚点保留和检索空间覆盖。
AI.result: 在任务增量指令微调、持续VQA、领域增量适应和终身多模态指令微调等任务上，InduceKV在匹配内存预算下持续优于PEFT、MoE、重放和提示检索基线。
AI.conclusion: InduceKV在固定内存预算下实现持续适应的性能提升，且增益并非来自更强的骨干模型、单纯的重放或无限的候选池。

title: Hidden Forgetting in Continual Multimodal Learning: When Accuracy Survives but Grounding Fails
summary: Multimodal large language models must continually adapt to evolving tasks and domains, yet standard continual learning metrics mainly measure whether old answers remain correct, leaving the stability of multimodal grounding largely unexamined. We study this overlooked failure mode and ask whether a continually adapted MLLM can preserve not only what it answers, but also how it uses visual, textual, OCR, chart, and document evidence. We identify \emph{hidden evidence-use forgetting}, where answer accuracy is retained while the model silently shifts toward different or less grounded evidence channels, and propose \textsc{RCL}, a replay-free reliance-constrained continual learning framework. \textsc{RCL} freezes the previous checkpoint as a behavioral reference, estimates teacher and student evidence-reliance profiles through counterfactual channel interventions, and jointly optimizes task learning, prediction preservation, and reliance preservation without adding inference-time cost. Across CoIN, COAST, MCITlib, and an evidence-sensitive multimodal stream, \textsc{RCL} consistently improves final performance and reduces forgetting over replay-free, PEFT, routing, and memory-assisted baselines, while substantially lowering modality reliance drift, dominant evidence flips, and hidden forgetting rates. These results suggest that robust continual multimodal learning requires preserving the evidence path behind correct answers, not merely the answers themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的遗忘模式——隐式证据使用遗忘，即多模态大模型在持续学习中答案正确但使用的证据通道发生偏移。为此设计了无需回放的RCL框架，通过冻结历史模型作为行为参考，利用反事实通道干预估计证据依赖轮廓，同时优化任务学习、预测保持和证据依赖保持。实验表明RCL在多个基准上优于现有方法，显著降低了模态依赖漂移和隐式遗忘率。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习指标仅衡量答案是否正确，忽略了多模态模型在使用视觉、文本、OCR、图表和文档等证据时的稳定性。作者发现存在隐式证据使用遗忘这一被忽视的失败模式，即答案准确率保持但模型悄然转向不同或更弱的证据通道。
AI.method: 提出RCL框架，包括：1) 冻结历史检查点作为行为参考；2) 通过反事实通道干预估计教师和学生模型的证据依赖轮廓；3) 联合优化任务学习、预测保持和证据依赖保持，且不增加推理成本。
AI.result: 在CoIN、COAST、MCITlib及一个证据敏感的多模态流上，RCL在最终性能和遗忘减少上持续优于无回放、PEFT、路由和记忆辅助基线，并显著降低了模态依赖漂移、主导证据翻转和隐式遗忘率。
AI.conclusion: 稳健的持续多模态学习不仅需要保持正确答案本身，更需要保持正确答案背后的证据路径。

title: Sparse-Aware Vector Quantization for Bandwidth-Efficient Collaborative 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction
summary: Collaborative perception extends single-agent perception by enabling multiple vehicles to exchange complementary perceptual information. However, it introduces an inherent trade-off between perception gain and communication overhead, which is particularly severe for 3D semantic occupancy prediction that relies on fine-grained spatial structures. Existing methods typically compress 3D features into 2D, causing severe spatial information loss, or transmit dense 3D representations, hindering real-world deployment. To overcome these limitations, we propose a bandwidth-efficient collaborative Vector Quantization Semantic Occupancy Prediction (VQSOP) framework. VQSOP employs a Sparse-Aware Vector Quantization (SAVQ) mechanism that exploits 3D scene sparsity to compactly encode informative regions, drastically reducing communication overhead while preserving complete geometric context. Furthermore, to enhance structural consistency and feature continuity, we design a Dual-Branch Adaptive Spatial Refinement (ASR) module that dynamically fuses local high-frequency details with broad contextual semantics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing communication volume by up to 82x.

AI.tldr: 提出带宽高效的VQSOP框架，通过稀疏感知向量量化（SAVQ）压缩3D占用特征，结合双分支自适应空间细化（ASR）模块，在保持高精度语义占用预测的同时，将通信量降低高达82倍。
AI.motivation: 现有协同感知方法在3D语义占用预测中面临感知增益与通信开销的固有矛盾：压缩3D特征到2D会导致严重空间信息丢失，而传输稠密3D表示又阻碍实际部署。
AI.method: 1. 稀疏感知向量量化（SAVQ）：利用3D场景稀疏性对信息区域进行紧凑编码，降低通信开销同时保留完整几何上下文。2. 双分支自适应空间细化（ASR）模块：动态融合局部高频细节与全局语义上下文，增强结构一致性与特征连续性。
AI.result: 在多项实验上达到最先进性能，同时将通信量降低高达82倍。
AI.conclusion: VQSOP有效解决了协同感知中通信效率与感知精度的权衡问题，为实现实际部署提供了可行的解决方案。

title: PACE: A Proxy for Agentic Capability Evaluation
summary: Evaluating LLM agents on benchmarks like SWE-Bench and GAIA can be expensive, time-consuming, and requires complex infrastructure. A single evaluation can cost thousands of dollars and take days to complete. In contrast, non-agentic LLM benchmarks that test individual capabilities (e.g., reasoning, code generation) are fast and cheap to run. In this paper, we investigate whether performance on expensive agentic benchmarks can be accurately predicted by the performance on a small, carefully selected subset of atomic evaluation instances. We introduce PACE, a framework that constructs proxy benchmarks by selecting instances from existing non-agentic evaluations whose aggregate scores most reliably predict model performances on agentic benchmarks. Given a pool of candidate instances spanning atomic capabilities, PACE fits a regression that maps a model's scores on a compact subset of source instances to its score on the target agentic benchmark. The subset itself is curated by combining two complementary instance-selection strategies, target-relevance local selection and globally informative global selection. We apply PACE to the 4 target agentic benchmarks in this paper, which yields PACE-Bench, the concrete proxy benchmark that we evaluate in the paper. Experiments across 14 models, 4 agentic benchmarks, and 19 non-agentic benchmarks show that PACE-Bench predicts agentic scores with leave-one-out cross-validation (LOOCV) mean absolute error (MAE) under 4%, Spearman correlation above 0.80, and pairwise model-ranking accuracy around 85%, all at much less than 1% of the full agentic evaluation cost. We further analyze the selected proxy instances, revealing which skills each agentic benchmark uniquely demands. PACE enables practitioners to obtain reliable estimates of agentic performance during model development, selection, and routing, without the overhead of full agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: PACE是一个框架，通过从非智能体评测中精选少量原子能力测试实例来构建代理评测集，从而以不到1%的成本高精度预测智能体基准性能（LOOCV MAE<4%, Spearman>0.80）。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准评测（如SWE-Bench、GAIA）耗时长、成本高（数千美元、数天），而传统非智能体评测快速且廉价。本文探究能否通过少量精心挑选的非智能体评测实例来准确预测智能体基准性能，以降低评估开销。
AI.method: 提出PACE框架，从非智能体评测池中通过两种互补策略（目标相关局部选择+全局信息选择）选取紧凑子集，拟合回归模型将模型在源实例上的得分映射到目标智能体基准得分，构建代理评测集PACE-Bench。
AI.result: 在14个模型、4个智能体基准、19个非智能体基准上，PACE-Bench预测智能体得分LOOCV MAE低于4%，Spearman相关系数高于0.80，模型对排名准确率约85%，成本低于完整智能体评测的1%。
AI.conclusion: PACE使实践者能在模型开发、选择和路由过程中以极低开销获得可靠的智能体性能估计，无需进行完整的智能体评测。

title: LiZAD: A Lightweight Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection Framework for Industrial Manufacturing
comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Omni-Layer Intelligent Systems (COINS) 2026
summary: In modern high-throughput industrial production lines, product configurations and visual characteristics frequently change, making it impractical to collect and annotate data for every new scenario. This dynamic setting makes Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection (ZSAD) particularly suitable, as it enables defect detection without requiring training on target-specific samples. Although recent ZSAD approaches show promising results, they are computationally intensive and thus unsuitable for deployment on resource-constrained devices. We propose LiZAD: a lightweight framework designed for real-time ZSAD specifically tailored for use on edge devices. The proposed approach pairs the dense and spatially aware visual features of DINOv3, crucial for precise pixel-level localization, with the highly computationally efficient text embeddings of MobileCLIP2. These features are then mapped into a shared latent space via low-memory trainable projection heads. Compared to six state-of-the-art ZSAD models, LiZAD achieves an average memory reduction of 61.5%, a parameter reduction of 74.6%, and a speedup of 3.02x in terms of latency. Despite substantial reductions in computational and memory costs, our approach maintains competitive anomaly detection performance, dropping the average P-AUROC by just 6.4% relative to the best state-of-the-art model across the VisA, BTAD, MPDD, and MVTec-AD datasets. Finally, it is successfully deployed on the NVIDIA Jetson NX and Jetson AGX edge devices and tested on the real production line of the Industrial Computer Engineering Laboratory (ICE Lab) at the University of Verona. The code is available at https://github.com/intelligolabs/LiZAD.

AI.tldr: LiZAD是一种轻量级零样本异常检测框架，专为边缘设备实时检测设计。通过结合DINOv3的密集视觉特征与MobileCLIP2的高效文本嵌入，并映射到共享潜在空间，在显著降低计算和内存开销的同时保持了竞争性检测性能，并成功部署于NVIDIA Jetson边缘设备及实际产线。
AI.motivation: 现代高通量工业产线中产品配置和视觉特征频繁变化，传统方法需要为每个新场景收集和标注数据，成本高昂。现有零样本异常检测方法虽然效果不错，但计算量过大，无法部署在资源受限的边缘设备上。
AI.method: LiZAD将DINOv3的密集空间感知视觉特征与MobileCLIP2的高效文本嵌入结合，通过低内存可训练的投影头将两者映射到共享潜在空间，实现轻量化的零样本异常检测。
AI.result: 相比六种最先进ZSAD模型，LiZAD平均内存减少61.5%，参数量减少74.6%，延迟加速3.02倍。在VisA、BTAD、MPDD和MVTec-AD数据集上，P-AUROC仅下降6.4%。成功部署于NVIDIA Jetson NX和AGX边缘设备，并在真实产线测试。
AI.conclusion: LiZAD在大幅降低计算和内存成本的同时，保持了具有竞争力的异常检测性能，适合在边缘设备上实时部署。

title: Algebraic Model Counting for Global Analysis of Optimal Decision Trees
comment: Proc. Joint European Conference on Machine Learning and Principles and Practice of Knowledge Discovery in Databases (ECML-PKDD 2026), LNCS, Naples, Italy, 7-11 September 2026
summary: Ensuring model reliability in Explainable AI requires a global assessment of the hypothesis space. We propose a formal framework for the exhaustive analysis of optimal and near-optimal decision trees, called Algebraic Decision Tree Counting (ADTC). Inspired by Algebraic Model Counting (AMC) in knowledge representation, ADTC reformulates diverse analytical tasks, such as optimization, counting, and sampling, into a unified sum-of-products computation over a semiring $R$. While the hypothesis space of decision trees is doubly exponential with respect to the maximum depth $Δ$, our dynamic programming algorithm achieves $O^*(n^{O(Δ)})$ time complexity in the number of features $n$, where $O^*$ suppresses polynomial factors. To handle complex constraints consisting of multiple tree metrics, we introduce model behavior tensors that aggregate semiring values via convolution products over a tensor semiring. This algebraic approach efficiently constructs a model profile that captures the global landscape and trade-offs between criteria such as accuracy, size, and fairness. We demonstrate the utility of our software, emtrees, on real-world datasets, illustrating how ADTC facilitates evidence-based model selection in sensitive domains.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为代数决策树计数（ADTC）的形式化框架，用于对最优和次优决策树进行穷举分析，通过将多种分析任务统一为半环上的和积计算，并利用动态规划算法高效探索假设空间，最终构建模型行为张量以刻画全局景观与多准则权衡。
AI.motivation: 确保可解释AI中模型的可靠性需要全局评估假设空间，而现有方法缺乏对最优和次优决策树的穷举分析能力。
AI.method: 受代数模型计数（AMC）启发，将优化、计数、采样等任务统一为半环上的和积计算；设计动态规划算法实现$O^*(n^{O(Δ)})$时间复杂度；引入模型行为张量，通过张量半环上的卷积聚合多个树度量约束。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上展示了emtrees软件的实际效用，验证了ADTC能够支持敏感领域中基于证据的模型选择。
AI.conclusion: ADTC提供了一种代数化的全局分析框架，能够高效刻画决策树假设空间的全局景观，并在多个准则（如准确率、大小、公平性）之间进行权衡，有助于可解释AI中的可靠模型选择。

title: Personalized 4D Whole-Heart Mesh Reconstruction from Cine MRI via Multi-Scale Temporal Modeling and Differentiable Contour Rendering
summary: Accurate 4D whole-heart mesh reconstruction from sparse cine MRI is critical for creating cardiac digital twins, but remains challenging due to limited 2D slice coverage and the complex coupling between cardiac shape and motion. Existing methods often rely on intermediate contour fitting and typically reconstruct static, single-phase, or partial cardiac geometries, limiting their ability to capture full-chamber dynamics. We propose a novel end-to-end framework for reconstructing temporally resolved whole-heart meshes from multi-view 2D cine MRI sequences by learning an image-to-mesh mapping. The framework incorporates a differentiable contour renderer inspired by the Beer-Lambert attenuation principle, enabling anatomy-aware supervision of 3D+t mesh deformation through contour-based projection losses. To improve temporal consistency across the cardiac cycle, we further introduce a multi-scale temporal modeling module that integrates global cycle-level dynamics with local inter-frame coherence to generate smooth and physiologically plausible mesh trajectories. The proposed method achieved a whole-heart mean absolute error of 1.68 $\pm$ 0.31 mm and a motion jitter of 0.77 $\pm$ 0.17 $\mathrm{mm}/\mathrm{frame}^{3}$, outperforming existing methods with lower reconstruction error and substantially improved motion smoothness. It also improved 2D contour alignment across multiple cine MRI views and supported downstream proof-of-concept electrophysiological simulation. The code will be released publicly upon acceptance of the manuscript for publication.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种端到端框架，从稀疏多视角2D电影MRI序列中直接重建4D全心网格，通过可微轮廓渲染器和多尺度时序建模模块，实现了高精度和运动平滑的重建效果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖中间轮廓拟合，且通常只能重建静态、单相位或部分心脏几何结构，难以捕捉完整心腔动力学，无法实现从稀疏2D MRI到4D全心网格的端到端重建。
AI.method: 提出端到端图像到网格映射框架，包含：(1) 基于Beer-Lambert衰减原理的可微轮廓渲染器，通过轮廓投影损失实现解剖感知监督；(2) 多尺度时序建模模块，结合全局周期动力学与局部帧间一致性，生成平滑生理合理的网格轨迹。
AI.result: 全心平均绝对误差1.68±0.31mm，运动抖动0.77±0.17mm/帧³，优于现有方法；改善了多视图MRI轮廓对齐，支持下游电生理仿真。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了从稀疏cine MRI到4D全心网格的高精度、平滑重建，为心脏数字孪生和临床电生理仿真提供了有效支撑。

title: Evidence-State Rewards for Long-Context Reasoning
summary: Long-context reasoning requires models to locate, revise, and synthesize evidence distributed across lengthy inputs. Existing long-context RL methods usually reward final answers or static evidence extraction, offering little feedback on how intermediate actions change the model's evidence state. We propose Maven, a reinforcement learning framework with an editable evidence memory. Maven defines an answer-conditioned evidence-state value and rewards action-level state transitions: add actions are credited by marginal gain and hindsight contribution, link actions by evidence synergy, and drop actions by improved answer support after removing misleading evidence. These rewards are assigned to the corresponding action spans in GRPO. Across Llama and Qwen models on LongBench v2, LongReason, and RULER, Maven outperforms outcome-only RL and evidence-identification baselines, producing more sufficient evidence sets and lower distractor retention. Our results show that long-context RL benefits from optimizing stateful evidence navigation rather than one-shot evidence extraction.

AI.tldr: Maven提出了一种带可编辑证据记忆的强化学习框架，通过细粒度动作级奖励（添加、链接、删除证据）来优化长上下文推理中的证据导航过程，在多个基准测试上优于传统结果奖励和证据提取方法。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文RL方法通常只奖励最终答案或静态证据提取，缺乏对中间动作如何改变模型证据状态的反馈，导致模型难以有效定位、修订和综合分布在大段输入中的证据。
AI.method: 提出Maven框架，包含可编辑证据记忆；定义答案条件化的证据状态值，为添加、链接、删除三种动作分别设计细粒度奖励（边际增益、事后贡献、证据协同、改进答案支持度），并在GRPO中将奖励分配到对应的动作跨度上。
AI.result: 在Llama和Qwen模型上，于LongBench v2、LongReason、RULER等基准测试中，Maven在证据集的充分性和干扰项保留率上均优于仅结果RL和证据识别基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文RL应当优化状态化的证据导航过程，而非一次性证据提取，这能带来更优的推理性能。

title: SUNTA: Hierarchical Video Prediction with Surprise-based Chunking
summary: Hierarchical state-space models (HSSMs) offer a promising approach to long-horizon prediction by segmenting sequences into temporal chunks. However, their performance hinges on how chunk boundaries are determined. While prior HSSMs typically rely on fixed-length chunking or similarity-based boundary detection, these methods often misalign with the intrinsic temporal structure of the data. We argue that chunking should instead be driven by prediction errors, which more directly indicate when longer-range context becomes necessary. Nevertheless, integrating surprise-based chunking into HSSMs introduces critical challenges, including hierarchical collapse during end-to-end training and the absence of surprise signals during open-loop prediction. To address these issues, we propose Surprise-based Nested Temporal Abstraction (SUNTA), a method that employs a decoupled training strategy to preserve surprise signals and uses internal inconsistency as a top-down surprise metric to determine chunk boundaries within imagined rollouts. Experiments on video prediction tasks in 2D and 3D environments demonstrate that SUNTA outperforms baselines, uniquely maintaining accurate predictions over 250 timesteps, whereas all baselines degrade within the first 10 timesteps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SUNTA方法，通过预测误差驱动的惊喜度分块策略和去耦训练机制，在长时序视频预测任务中实现了250时间步的稳定预测，远超基线模型（10步内退化）。
AI.motivation: 现有分层状态空间模型（HSSM）使用固定长度或基于相似性的分块方式，无法对齐数据的固有时间结构；而预测误差更能指示何时需要长程上下文，但将惊喜度分块引入HSSM面临层级坍缩和开环预测中惊喜信号缺失等挑战。
AI.method: 提出SUNTA方法：1）采用去耦训练策略保持惊喜信号；2）使用内部不一致性作为自上而下的惊喜度指标，在想象推演中确定分块边界。
AI.result: 在2D和3D环境视频预测任务中，SUNTA在250时间步内保持准确预测，而所有基线模型在10步内即出现退化。
AI.conclusion: 基于预测误差的惊喜度分块策略结合去耦训练，能有效提升HSSM的长时序预测能力。

title: ContextNest: Verifiable Context Governance for Autonomous AI Agent
summary:
Autonomous AI agents increasingly depend on external knowledge stores, yet most retrieval pipelines provide relevance without durable guarantees of provenance, version identity, integrity, traceability, or point-in-time reconstruction. We formalize this as context governance and present ContextNext, an open specification and reference implementation for governed AI-consumable knowledge vaults. ContextNext does not replace Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG); it supplies the governance layer beneath retrieval, determining which artifacts are approved, current, attributable, and integrity-verified before retrieval systems operate over them.
  The specification combines typed Markdown documents with metadata, deterministic set-algebraic selectors, contextnest:// URI references, SHA-256 hash-chained version histories, graph-level checkpoints, source nodes for live data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and audit traces of agent context consumption. These mechanisms let organizations reconstruct which knowledge versions informed an agent output and whether those versions were AI-eligible when consumed.
  We report first empirical results from two controlled experiments. In a stale-version attack isolating the governance-versus-retrieval failure mode, governed selection strictly Pareto-dominates BM25 sparse retrieval, with higher answer-quality pass rate (97% versus 93-90%) at about one-third the input-token cost. In a retrieval-determinism experiment over a 1,060-document corpus, deterministic selectors and BM25 return stable document sets across repeated identical queries (Jaccard 1.0), while a dense+HNSW baseline is non-deterministic on 80% of queries (mean Jaccard 0.611, worst case 0.210). These results suggest that context governance addresses failure modes retrieval quality alone is not designed to resolve. We release a core engine, CLI, and MCP server under open licenses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ContextNext，一个为AI代理提供上下文治理（context governance）的开放规范与参考实现。它在RAG检索之前增加治理层，确保知识工件的来源、版本完整性、可追溯性和时间点可重建性。实验表明，该方案在抗陈旧版本攻击和检索确定性上显著优于传统BM25和稠密检索方法。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理日益依赖外部知识存储，但现有检索流程只提供相关性，缺乏对来源、版本身份、完整性、可追溯性或时间点重建的持久保证。作者将此问题形式化为"上下文治理"，并旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: ContextNext规范结合了：带元数据的类型化Markdown文档、确定性集合代数选择器、contextnest:// URI引用、SHA-256哈希链版本历史、图级检查点、通过模型上下文协议（MCP）的实时数据源节点，以及代理上下文消费的审计追踪。
AI.result: 1) 在陈旧版本攻击实验中，治理选择严格帕累托支配BM25稀疏检索，答案质量通过率97%对93-90%，输入Token成本仅为约1/3。2) 在检索确定性实验中，确定性选择器和BM25在重复查询中返回稳定文档集（Jaccard系数1.0），而dense+HNSW基线在80%的查询上非确定性（平均Jaccard 0.611，最差0.210）。
AI.conclusion: 上下文治理能够解决检索质量本身无法解决的故障模式。作者已开源核心引擎、CLI和MCP服务器。

title: MolSight: A Graph-Aware Vision-Language Model for Unified Chemical Image Understanding
summary: Using molecular large language models (LLMs) as a unified framework for understanding molecular structures and functions is emerging as a new trend in tasks such as molecular design and drug discovery. However, these models struggle to fully capture the visual representation of molecular structures, limiting their potential. While existing molecular vision-language models (VLMs) show promise, they still face challenges in structural alignment and lack the necessary topological modeling for accurate molecular understanding. To address this, we propose MolSight, a graph-aware vision-language model framework designed to enhance the understanding of molecular images by VLMs. MolSight integrates a Molecular Topology Module to inject chemical-bond adjacency information into vision tokens, and a Molecular Grounding Module to align visual features with chemical symbolic semantics. Our experiments demonstrate that MolSight significantly outperforms existing VLMs, molecular LLMs, and specialized tools across multiple chemical visual understanding tasks, achieving a new level of molecular image reasoning.

AI.tldr: MolSight是一个图感知的视觉-语言模型框架，通过分子拓扑模块和分子基础模块增强VLMs对分子图像的理解，在多个化学视觉理解任务上显著优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有分子LLMs难以充分捕获分子结构的视觉表征，而分子视觉-语言模型存在结构对齐不足、缺乏拓扑建模的问题，限制了分子理解能力。
AI.method: MolSight包含两个核心模块：(1) 分子拓扑模块，将化学键邻接信息注入视觉token；(2) 分子基础模块，将视觉特征与化学符号语义对齐。
AI.result: 在多个化学视觉理解任务上，MolSight显著优于现有VLMs、分子LLMs和专门工具，达到了分子图像推理的新水平。
AI.conclusion: MolSight通过引入图感知的拓扑建模和视觉-语义对齐，有效增强了VLM对分子结构的理解能力，为分子图像推理提供了更优方案。

title: Enhancing Fitness Intelligence through Domain-Specific LLM Post-Training
comment: 8 pages, 6 tables, 2 figures. Accepted by the 12th International Conference on Big Data Computing and Communications (BigCom 2026)
summary: Scientific Fitness Coaching (SFC) is typically delivered by human professionals, making it costly and inaccessible to many. While recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) show considerable promise for more inclusive fitness coaching, directly deploying prevailing general-purpose LLMs in SFC reveals critical limitations. These models often lack sufficient domain-specific knowledge integration, leading to weak performance on complex SFC scenarios. In this paper, we introduce FitOne, a series of fitness LLMs (with 8B and 32B parameters) designed to improve reliability and domain specialization for SFC applications. Built upon the Qwen3 foundation models, FitOne is developed through a three-stage post-training pipeline consisting of continual pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning, using large-scale, high-quality datasets derived from rigorous knowledge engineering. We conduct comprehensive evaluations of FitOne on professional fitness certification exams, including ACSM-EP and NSCA-CSCS, as well as general capabilities such as knowledge reasoning and instruction following. Experimental results show that, while retaining strong general capabilities, FitOne-8B/32B achieves average improvements of up to 10.09%/9.29% and 12.73%/7.01% on the ACSM-EP and NSCA-CSCS exams, respectively, compared with the Qwen3 base models. Furthermore, in-depth ablation studies confirm the necessity of each training stage, highlighting the pipeline's effectiveness in balancing domain expertise enhancement with general ability retention. We believe this research advances LLM systems toward more reliable fitness intelligence and will inspire future research on developing domain-specific LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FitOne系列健身大语言模型（8B/32B参数），通过三阶段后训练流程（持续预训练、监督微调、强化学习）提升科学健身教练领域的专业性和可靠性。在ACSM-EP和NSCA-CSCS专业认证考试中，相比Qwen3基座模型，FitOne-8B/32B分别平均提升10.09%/9.29%和12.73%/7.01%，同时保留了强大的通用能力。
AI.motivation: 传统科学健身教练依赖人类专业人士，成本高且难以普及。虽然通用大语言模型有潜力，但缺乏领域知识整合，在复杂健身场景中表现不佳。因此需要开发专用的健身领域LLM。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3基座模型，采用三阶段后训练流程：1）持续预训练；2）监督微调；3）强化学习。训练数据来源于大规模、高质量、经过严格知识工程处理的领域数据集。
AI.result: FitOne-8B/32B在ACSM-EP考试上平均提升10.09%/9.29%，在NSCA-CSCS考试上平均提升12.73%/7.01%，同时保持强大的通用能力（知识推理、指令遵循）。消融实验验证了三阶段训练流程的必要性。
AI.conclusion: FitOne系列模型推动了LLM系统向更可靠的健身智能方向发展，三阶段训练流程在平衡领域专业性与通用能力保持方面表现有效，为未来领域专用LLM的研发提供了参考。

title: Coding-agents can replicate scientific machine learning papers
summary: Scientific machine learning papers typically make computational claims, e.g., that the relative mean square error is less than 5% or that the 95% predictive credible interval covers the test data. A coding agent can be prompted to replicate those claims from paper materials alone, but the prompt does not by itself reliably preserve progress or check whether generated evidence supports the paper's claims. We introduce Paper-replication, a workflow that makes each selected paper claim a target with recorded evidence, and implement it as a coding-agent skill. The workflow makes the agent record those targets, reconstruct the paper's method, run computational experiments, link generated outputs to provenance and comparisons with the paper's claims, record where matched evidence appears in the replication report, and pass validation checks before completion. We evaluate Paper-replication on twelve independent runs across four scientific machine learning papers. All twelve workspaces pass the completion gate, and all 158 recorded targets are matched with report coverage. Even in this completed workspace state, repeated runs differ in how papers are divided into targets, in numerical fidelity to the source papers, in elapsed replication time, in the number of intermediate executions replaced before final evidence is accepted, and in the rules used to accept evidence. Paper-replication makes completion depend on workspace evidence and validation checks rather than on the agent's final message.

AI.tldr: 提出Paper-replication工作流，将论文中的计算指标设为可验证目标，通过编码智能体自动复现并验证结果，在4篇机器学习论文的12次运行中全部通过验证。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习论文通常包含计算指标声明，但仅靠提示词无法可靠地复现这些声明，也无法验证生成证据是否支持论文主张。需要一种系统化的工作流来确保复现过程的可靠性和证据的可追溯性。
AI.method: Paper-replication工作流：将论文声明设为可记录目标→重构论文方法→运行计算实验→将输出链接到来源并与论文声明比较→记录匹配证据在复现报告中的位置→通过验证检查后才完成。以编码智能体技能形式实现。
AI.result: 在4篇论文的12次独立运行中，所有工作区均通过完成门控，158个记录目标全部匹配报告覆盖。重复运行在目标划分、数值保真度、耗时、中间执行替换次数、证据接受规则等方面存在差异。
AI.conclusion: Paper-replication使完成状态依赖于工作区证据和验证检查，而非智能体的最终消息，提供了一种更可靠的论文计算声明复现方法。

title: Understanding Geometric Representations in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers via Subspace Intervention
summary: We introduce a controlled subspace intervention framework to investigate how self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs) encode dense geometric information. While linear probing is widely used to assess geometric representations, it treats features as a black box, failing to disentangle the underlying topology. To address this issue, we decompose the weights of converged linear probes to isolate the low-rank subspaces containing explicit geometric signals using Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). Our perspective yields three key insights: (1) Pre-training objectives determine how features are encoded. DINOv2 aligns spatial features for efficient linear extraction, while Masked Autoencoders (MAE) tend to disperse these signals, requiring a broader spatial context. (2) Explicit geometric representations are highly compressible, suggesting dense predictive heads could potentially be constrained to low-rank subspaces with minimal performance loss. (3) The layer-wise task affinity suggests that geometric precision peaks at intermediate layers before yielding to semantic abstraction in the final layers. By connecting internal encoding mechanics with downstream performance, these findings provide a basis for effective feature selection and lightweight decoder design. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zhou-Weichen/Geosubprobe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种控制子空间干预框架，通过SVD分解线性探测权重，揭示自监督Vision Transformer（ViT）中密集几何信息的编码机制。研究发现：预训练目标影响特征编码方式（DINOv2对齐空间特征，MAE分散信号）；几何表示高度可压缩；几何精度在中间层达到峰值，最终层转向语义抽象。
AI.motivation: 现有线性探测方法将特征视为黑箱，无法解耦自监督ViT中几何信息的底层拓扑结构，因此需要一种可解释的方法来揭示几何信号是如何在模型内部编码和分布的。
AI.method: 对收敛的线性探测权重进行奇异值分解（SVD），提取包含显式几何信号的低秩子空间，构建控制子空间干预框架来分析ViT的几何信息编码机制。
AI.result: （1）DINOv2倾向于对齐空间特征以支持线性提取，而MAE分散几何信号，需要更广的空间上下文；（2）显式几何表示高度可压缩，密集预测头可约束至低秩子空间且性能损失极小；（3）几何精度在中间层最高，最终层转向语义抽象。
AI.conclusion: 该框架连接了内部编码机制与下游性能，为特征选择与轻量化解码器设计提供了理论依据。

title: ESC: Emotional Self-Correction for Reliable Vision-Language Models
comment: ECCV Main Track 2026 (113 pages, 15 tables, 65 figures). Project Page: https://genai4e.github.io/ESC/?
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse multimodal tasks, yet they remain vulnerable to unreliable reasoning. Existing self-correction methods mitigate these issues but typically rely on post-training or carefully engineered feedback, incurring high computational cost. In this work, we revisit this challenge through the lens of emotional cues, asking whether they can activate latent self-correction behaviors in VLMs without additional training. \textbf{We find that emotional signals serve as an effective trigger for self-correction, encouraging more cautious and reflective reasoning}. Motivated by this finding, we propose \escabstract (\textbf{\underline{E}}motional \textbf{\underline{S}}elf-\textbf{\underline{C}}orrection), a training-free self-correction framework. ESC introduces an external verifier that detects potentially incorrect initial responses and injects emotional feedback to encourage model to reflect, and produce a better revised response without additional training. Extensive experiments across safety, hallucination, vision-centric perception, and multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that ESC consistently improves reliability while preserving overall model utility. These results suggest that emotion can function not only as an ability to be recognized, but also as a practical control signal for scalable self-correction in VLMs. \textbf{We therefore believe that ESC provides a strong foundation for a new reliable human-like, emotion-integrated research direction.} Our project is publicly available at \textcolor{red}{https://genai4e.github.io/ESC/}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需额外训练的情感自纠正框架（ESC），通过注入情感信号激活视觉语言模型的内在自我纠正能力，在安全、幻觉、感知和多模态推理等多个基准上显著提升模型可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）在面对多模态任务时存在不可靠推理的问题，现有的自我纠正方法依赖后训练或精心设计的反馈，计算成本高。作者希望探索能否利用情感线索在不增加训练成本的情况下激活VLM的自我纠正行为。
AI.method: 提出ESC（Emotional Self-Correction）框架，包含一个外部验证器检测潜在的初始错误回答，然后注入情感反馈信号，激励模型进行反思并生成修正后的回答，整个过程无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在安全、幻觉、视觉感知和多模态推理等多个基准上，ESC持续提升了模型的可靠性，同时保持了模型的整体效用。
AI.conclusion: 情感不仅可以作为一种被识别的能力，还可以作为VLM中可扩展自我纠正的实用控制信号，为可靠、类人的情感集成研究方向奠定了坚实基础。

title: A$^{2}$utoLPBench: An Auto-Generated, Agent-Friendly LP Benchmark via Inverse-KKT Construction
summary: Most LP-from-text benchmarks are static datasets of word problems written and labeled by hand. Once such a dataset is released, its size is fixed, its difficulty is fixed, and every problem can leak into the training data of future LLMs. We present \textbf{A$^{2}$utoLPBench}, a benchmark for testing LLM-driven agents on linear programming problems written in plain text. We first pick a feasible point and dual, then write down a problem for which that point is optimal and the objective value is known. The answer is known by construction, with no solver call and no human annotator. The evaluation environment bundles a reference solver-critic baseline and a Docker image whose usage instructions are written for an LLM-driven agent to read. With these in place, any agent can run the benchmark and get a calibrated score with one command. Because the benchmark is a generator rather than a fixed dataset, it has properties no fixed dataset can match: an unlimited supply of fresh problems, a difficulty knob set by $(n,m)$, ground-truth answers correct by construction, low LLM-side cost per problem relative to human authoring, repeatable scores across independent batches, and resistance to training-data leakage when fresh post-cutoff seed ranges are used.

AI.tldr: A$^{2}$utoLPBench是一个可无限生成的线性规划文本问题基准，通过构造法确保答案正确，支持难度调节，并能抵抗训练数据泄露。
AI.motivation: 现有LP文本基准是静态数据集，存在规模固定、难度固定、易泄露到LLM训练数据等问题。
AI.method: 先选取可行点和其对偶，然后构造一个使该点最优且目标值已知的问题。答案由构造保证正确，无需求解器调用或人工标注。基准以生成器形式实现，并附带求解器-评论基线及Docker镜像。
AI.result: 该基准可无限生成新问题，支持通过(n,m)参数调节难度，答案构造正确，每个问题的LLM侧成本低，可跨独立批次获得可重复分数，且通过使用截止日期后的新种子范围可抵抗训练数据泄露。
AI.conclusion: A$^{2}$utoLPBench克服了静态数据集的所有局限，为LLM驱动的智能体评估LP问题求解能力提供了一个可扩展、可重复、抗泄露的标准化基准。

title: Training-free Controllable Human Motion Generation under Heterogeneous Constraints
summary: Training-free controllable motion generation has attracted growing interest for enabling flexible constraint enforcement without constraint-specific training. However, existing training-free methods require constraints to be continuous objective-based with differentiable losses, while many real-world requirements are criterion-based and provide only discontinuous, sparse, or even black-box feedback. In this paper, we propose Motion-Inference-as-Control (MIC), the first training-free motion generation framework that handles both continuous objective-based and criterion-based motion constraints under a shared mechanism. The key idea is to cast diffusion-based motion generation as a stochastic control problem. This perspective not only provides principled and practically effective step-wise control laws that support criterion-based constraints without requiring differentiability and naturally accommodate objective-based constraints as a special case, but also motivates a control-oriented constraint coordination mechanism that adaptively balances and reconciles motion constraints during generation. Experiments across diverse constraint settings demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 提出MIC框架，将扩散运动生成视为随机控制问题，首次统一处理连续目标约束和离散准则约束，无需额外训练。
AI.motivation: 现有无训练运动生成方法仅支持连续可微的目标约束，无法处理实际中常见的离散、稀疏或黑盒的准则约束，缺乏统一的约束处理机制。
AI.method: 将扩散运动生成建模为随机控制问题，推导出支持准则约束（无需可微性）的步进控制律，并设计面向控制的约束协调机制以自适应平衡多种约束。
AI.result: 在多种约束设置下的实验验证了框架的有效性，能同时处理连续目标约束和离散准则约束。
AI.conclusion: MIC是首个无训练运动生成框架，通过控制理论视角统一了不同类型的运动约束，为实际应用提供了更灵活的约束支持。

title: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Memory for a long-horizon LLM agent is a contract about what each future decision is allowed to see. The simplest contract appends past observations, tool calls, and reflections to every prompt, which makes prior context easy to access but also turns it into a jumbled mixture in which the effect of any single memory component is hard to isolate. We introduce and instrument an alternative bounded contract: every decision is made from a fresh user message assembled by typed retrieval, with no raw cross-decision transcript appended. The prompt thus stays bounded across runs of any length, and any single layer can be ablated in isolation. We instantiate the contract in Slay the Spire 2, a closed-rule stochastic deck-building game whose runs require hundreds of tactical and strategic decisions. A public online benchmark of frontier LLMs on the same game reports zero wins at the lowest difficulty across five configurations, and the developer-reported human win rate at the same difficulty is 16%; the task is hard but not saturated. Within our harness, a fixed-A0 ablation shows the largest observed difference when triggered strategic skills are enabled: the no-store baseline wins 3/10 games and adding the skill layer 6/10. At this sample size the comparison is directional rather than statistically decisive (Fisher exact p\approx0.37); a cross-backbone probe and public accumulating-context baselines are reported as operational comparisons rather than controlled tests of the contract variable itself. We release a reproducible testbed: 298 completed trajectories with condition tags, frozen memory/skill snapshots, prompt records, and analysis scripts -- an agent design and a validated, reusable methodology for studying how explicit memory layers shape long-horizon LLM-agent decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于类型化检索的有限记忆契约（bounded contract），替代传统无限拼接历史上下文的记忆方式，并在《杀戮尖塔2》游戏中验证其效果。实验表明，在长时程LLM智能体决策中，选择性策略记忆层能提升胜率，但统计显著性有限。研究同时发布了可复现的测试平台。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM智能体通过拼接所有历史记录构建记忆，导致上下文杂乱、难以隔离单一记忆组件的影响。作者希望设计一种受约束的记忆契约，使得每次决策基于类型化检索而非原始历史转录，从而保持提示长度有界，并支持单层消融分析。
AI.method: 提出有限记忆契约：每次决策从全新的用户消息开始，通过类型化检索（typed retrieval）组装信息，不拼接原始跨决策转录。在《杀戮尖塔2》游戏中实现该契约，并与无记忆基线、累积上下文基线进行对比实验，通过消融分析测试策略技能层的效果。
AI.result: 固定A0消融实验中，无存储基线胜率3/10，加入策略技能层后胜率6/10，差异方向性显著但未达统计显著性（Fisher精确检验p≈0.37）。同时提供了跨骨干模型探测和累积上下文基线的操作对比。最终发布包含298条轨迹、条件标签、冻结快照和脚本的可复现测试平台。
AI.conclusion: 有限记忆契约是一种可行的长时程LLM智能体记忆设计方案，能支持单层消融分析。尽管策略技能层的提升效果在统计上不显著，但方向性结果提示显式记忆层对长时程决策有潜在影响。研究提供了可复现的方法论和测试平台，为后续研究奠定基础。

title: Mirror Illusion Art
comment: CVPR 2026 Highlight, also got an Efficient CVPR award
summary: Mirror Illusion Art is a novel reflection-conditioned 3D illusion where one object yields two target appearances (front and mirror). The task is formulated as inverse design from two target 2D images (front and mirror) to a printable 3D object with geometry and texture. Prior topology-driven and shadow-based approaches demand substantial manual effort, optimize shape only, and often yield non-smooth or incomplete geometry. To address these challenges, we propose AutoMIA, an automated Mirror Illusion Art design pipeline that jointly optimizes shape and color. To stabilize optimization and suppress artifacts, four mechanisms are introduced: (1) projection-alignment component (PAC) selection to reduce surface noise, (2) position-weighted adaptive (PWA) suppression for background noise, (3) internal voxel preservation (IVP) to prevent internal fractures, and (4) shape-color decoupled (SCD) optimization that balance shape and color optimization. AutoMIA generate diverse smooth Mirror Illusion artworks successfully both in the digital and physical world, with only around 76s design time and 2.6 GB memory on average using a single RTX 3090, advancing inverse graphics and computational design. Our code is available at https://github.com/zxp555/AutoMIA.

AI.tldr: AutoMIA是一种自动化镜像幻觉艺术设计管线，通过联合优化几何形状与颜色，在约76秒内生成可直接3D打印的光滑镜像幻觉物体。
AI.motivation: 现有拓扑驱动和基于阴影的方法需要大量人工操作，仅优化形状，且常产生不光滑或不完整的几何体，缺乏自动化、高质量的镜像幻觉艺术设计方法。
AI.method: 提出AutoMIA管线，联合优化形状与颜色，并引入四种机制：投影对齐组件(PAC)选择、位置加权自适应(PWA)背景抑制、内部体素保留(IVP)防断裂、形状-颜色解耦(SCD)优化。
AI.result: 平均设计时间约76秒，内存占用约2.6 GB（单张RTX 3090），可生成多样化且光滑的镜像幻觉艺术作品，并成功在数字和物理世界中呈现。
AI.conclusion: AutoMIA推动了逆向图形学与计算设计的发展，实现了高质量、高效率的自动化镜像幻觉艺术设计。

title: UA-ChatDev: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Agent Collaboration for Reliable Software Development
summary: Software development is a complex task that demands cooperation among agents with diverse roles. Large language models (LLMs) have enabled autonomous multi-agent software development frameworks that leverage role-based collaboration to automate requirements analysis, coding, testing, and refinement. However, existing approaches typically assume that intermediate agent outputs are equally reliable, leaving them vulnerable to hallucination propagation, where incorrect decisions generated in early development phases are transferred to downstream agents and negatively impact final software quality. To address this challenge, we propose UA-ChatDev, an uncertainty-aware multi-agent software development framework that integrates uncertainty quantification into agent interactions. It introduces a lightweight uncertainty estimation mechanism based on token-level log probabilities to assess the confidence of agent responses and employs phase-aware threshold calibration to selectively trigger retrieval-based verification when uncertainty exceeds acceptable levels. Extensive experiments on the SRDD benchmark demonstrate that UA-ChatDev consistently outperforms existing single-agent and multi-agent software development frameworks across completeness, executability, consistency, and overall quality metrics. Further ablation studies and communication analyses verify that uncertainty-aware interactions enhance code execution reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出UA-ChatDev，一个不确定性感知的多智能体软件开发框架，通过集成不确定性量化来抑制幻觉传播，在SRDD基准测试上表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体软件开发框架假设中间智能体输出同样可靠，导致早期阶段的错误决策（幻觉）会传播给下游智能体，降低最终软件质量。
AI.method: 在ChatDev基础上引入token级对数概率的轻量级不确定性估计机制，并结合阶段感知阈值校准，当不确定性超过阈值时触发基于检索的验证。
AI.result: 在SRDD基准测试上，UA-ChatDev在完整性、可执行性、一致性和整体质量指标上一致优于现有单智能体和多智能体软件开发框架。消融实验和通信分析验证了不确定性感知交互能增强代码执行可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知机制有效抑制了多智能体软件开发中的幻觉传播问题，提升了软件质量。

title: EvoPolicyGym: Evaluating Autonomous Policy Evolution in Interactive Environments
summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly expected to improve executable policies through feedback, yet existing evaluations often collapse this process into a final score or confound it with open-ended software-engineering progress. We introduce Autonomous Policy Evolution, a controlled evaluation setting in which a harness-model agent repeatedly edits an executable policy system under a fixed interaction budget. We instantiate this setting in EvoPolicyGym, a benchmark built from compact interactive RL environments that evaluates how agents iteratively improve explored policies. On the EvoPolicyGym suite, GPT-5.5 achieves the strongest aggregate rank score and top-two performance on all 16 environments. Beyond leaderboard results, EvoPolicyGym also provides trajectory-level diagnostics that distinguish how agents allocate budget, convert feedback into parametric tuning. These analyses show that strong autonomous policy evolution depends not only on isolated task wins, but on discovering task-appropriate mechanisms and refining policies under bounded feedback.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了自主策略进化（Autonomous Policy Evolution）这一受控评估框架，并构建了EvoPolicyGym基准测试。实验表明GPT-5.5在所有16个环境中取得最优表现，并通过轨迹级诊断揭示了预算分配、反馈转化等关键机制。
AI.motivation: 现有评估往往将智能体的策略改进过程简化为最终分数，或与开放式软件工程进展混淆，缺乏对策略迭代优化过程的受控评估。
AI.method: 提出自主策略进化（Autonomous Policy Evolution）评估框架，让一个"笼头模型"智能体在固定交互预算下反复编辑可执行策略系统。基于此构建EvoPolicyGym基准测试，使用紧凑的交互式RL环境评估智能体的迭代策略改进能力。
AI.result: GPT-5.5在EvoPolicyGym全部16个环境中取得最强势的聚合排名分数和前十名表现。轨迹级诊断显示强自主策略进化不仅依赖于孤立的任务胜利，还依赖于发现适合任务的机制并在有限反馈下优化策略。
AI.conclusion: 自主策略进化能力的关键在于预算分配、反馈转化为参数调优等机制，需要超越简单的任务获胜来评估智能体的策略改进过程。

title: Criticality-Based Guard Rail Validation for AI Agent Decisions in Autonomous Telecom Networks
summary: The evolution toward fully autonomous telecommunications networks (Autonomous Network Levels 4-5) requires AI/ML agents to make real-time network decisions without human intervention. However, no standardized runtime mechanism exists to intercept and validate individual inference outputs before they trigger live network state changes, creating risks of erroneous autonomous decisions. This paper proposes the Guard Rail Validation (GRV) framework, a standardizable runtime architecture for intercepting and validating AI-driven decisions before execution. The framework evaluates decisions across multiple weighted dimensions -- including action scope, action type, service criticality, agent autonomy level, reversibility, and temporal behavioural patterns -- to determine a criticality level. Based on this level, graduated validation mechanisms are applied: execute-with-logging, bounds checking, independent agent validation, or multi-agent consensus. The framework additionally provides cross-agent conflict detection with criticality-weighted priority resolution and runtime conformance logging for regulatory compliance (e.g., EU AI Act Article 14). We present the architecture, algorithmic procedures, O-RAN deployment model, and evaluate threat coverage against known AI/ML attacks in telecommunications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Guard Rail Validation (GRV)框架，用于在自治电信网络中拦截和验证AI/ML代理的推理输出，防止错误决策触发网络状态变更。框架通过多维度加权评估决策关键性，并应用渐进式验证机制（执行日志、边界检查、独立验证、多代理共识），支持跨代理冲突检测和运行时合规日志记录。
AI.motivation: 当电信网络向L4-L5级全自治演进时，AI/ML代理需实时做出网络决策，但缺乏标准化的运行时机制来拦截和验证单个推理输出，存在错误自治决策引发网络状态变更的风险。
AI.method: 提出GRV框架，对AI决策进行多维度加权评估（行动范围、类型、服务关键性、自治等级、可逆性、时间行为模式），确定关键性等级后应用渐进式验证机制（执行日志、边界检查、独立验证、多代理共识），并集成跨代理冲突检测与优先级裁决。
AI.result: 给出了完整的架构设计、算法流程、O-RAN部署模型，并评估了对已知电信领域AI/ML攻击的威胁覆盖情况。
AI.conclusion: GRV框架提供了一种可标准化、可扩展的运行时安全架构，确保AI驱动的自治决策在生效前被适当验证，同时满足欧盟AI法案等法规合规要求。

title: Purified OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation Without Losing How to Think
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving LLM reasoning, where a privileged teacher with access to reference solutions provides token-level supervision on the student's own generated trajectories. However, we find that OPSD consistently fails on long chain-of-thought (long-CoT) reasoning models, yielding at best marginal gains while destabilizing the reflective reasoning capability these models depend on. Through a novel decomposition of the teacher's supervision signal, we identify the root cause: the teacher's supervision is dominated by a reference-induced component that drives rote memorization of reference-specific shortcuts, while the question-conditioned, inference-transferable component is ignored or actively opposed. Based on this diagnosis, we propose a two-step solution. First, we construct a reference-only teacher (the same model conditioned on the reference without the question) to isolate the non-transferable component of the supervision signal; the residual after subtracting this component captures the question-conditioned, inference-transferable correction. Second, we use pointwise mutual information (PMI) as the mechanism to transform this residual into a well-formed PMI target distribution that the student can directly distill from, filtering out the reference-induced shortcut. Experiments on four long-CoT models across two datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over both the base model and standard OPSD, while preserving the models' natural epistemic behavior throughout training.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了在长思维链推理模型中，教师蒸馏信号被参考诱导成分主导，导致模型死记硬背而非学习可迁移推理能力。作者提出通过构建"仅参考教师"分离非可迁移成分，并利用点互信息（PMI）作为蒸馏目标，在多个长CoT模型上取得一致改进。
AI.motivation: 现有的自蒸馏方法（OPSD）在长思维链推理模型上效果不佳，甚至破坏模型的反思性推理能力，需要诊断根本原因并提出针对性解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 将教师监督信号分解为"参考诱导成分"和"问题条件化可迁移成分"；2) 构建"仅参考教师"（模型在给定参考但不给问题时的输出）来隔离非可迁移成分；3) 利用点互信息（PMI）将残差信号转化为适合学生蒸馏的目标分布，过滤参考诱导的捷径。
AI.result: 在四个长CoT模型和两个数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比基础模型和标准OPSD均取得一致改进，并能保持模型在整个训练过程中的自然认知行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过诊断OPSD失效的根本原因（参考诱导成分主导监督信号），提出基于PMI的参考分离蒸馏方法，有效解决了长CoT推理模型的自蒸馏问题。

title: What LLM Agents Say When No One Is Watching: Social Structure and Latent Objective Emergence in Multi-Agent Debates
summary: LLM agents will increasingly act in socially structured settings where role, audience, and relational context can shape what is advantageous or costly to say. We study whether such social structure, without any explicit objective in the prompt, changes what an agent expresses publicly relative to an off-the-record (OTR) channel elicited under the same condition. We introduce a dual-channel debate framework in which agents produce public utterances that enter the shared history alongside OTR responses that are recorded but never shown to the other participant. Across 10 models, 3 scenarios, and 5 variations within each scenario, alignment-inducing settings produce systematic public-OTR divergence in the targeted agent, with its decision divergence rising from a $\sim$3% baseline to roughly 40%. The effect is consistent across four aggregate analyses: stance, semantic similarity, natural language inference, and survey responses. In some cases, the OTR response explicitly attributes public accommodation to relational pressures, such as career risk or sponsorship obligation. The findings suggest that agent evaluation should extend beyond explicit goals and detect emergent objectives. We present a dual-channel evaluation framework and complementary behavioral measures that operationalize this assessment.

AI.tldr: LLM代理在社会结构化场景中会产生公开表达与私下表达的系统性分歧，当存在对齐诱导设置时，决策分歧率从约3%基线升至约40%。
AI.motivation: 研究社会结构（角色、受众、关系背景）如何在不设置显式目标的情况下，改变LLM代理的公开表达内容。
AI.method: 提出双通道辩论框架：公开话语进入共享历史，私下（OTR）响应被记录但不展示给对方。跨10个模型、3个场景、每场景5个变体进行实验。
AI.result: 对齐诱导设置下，目标代理的决策分歧率从约3%升至约40%。效果在四个指标（立场、语义相似度、自然语言推理、调查响应）上一致。部分OTR响应明确将公开让步归因于关系压力。
AI.conclusion: 代理评估应超越显式目标，检测涌现目标。提出了双通道评估框架及补充行为测量方法。

title: Copewell: A Multi-Agent Swarm Architecture for Equitable Mental Wellness Support
summary: Mental health disorders affect nearly one billion people globally, yet 75% of individuals in low- and middle-income countries receive no treatment due to workforce shortages, cost barriers, and stigma. Current AI-powered wellness solutions predominantly rely on single-mode conversational interfaces that suffer high abandonment rates and fail to provide measurable, immediate relief calibrated to users' dynamic emotional states. This paper presents Copewell, a novel multi-agent swarm system designed to expand access to mental wellness support through human-centered AI principles. Our architecture introduces three technical innovations: (1) a multi-source assessment framework integrating self-reported, physiological, and contextual data to mitigate algorithmic bias; (2) valence-arousal emotion mapping using Russell's Circumplex Model of Affect to route users to specialized AI agents; and (3) dual-mode intervention delivery combining conversational support with evidence-based sensory wellness protocols. We examine the sociotechnical design considerations underlying Copewell's development, including a privacy-first architecture, embedded ethical oversight through a dedicated Ethics Supervisor agent, and participatory design informed by mental health practitioners. Early practitioner engagement and beta deployment inform design decisions and identify directions for future empirical evaluation. This work contributes to responsible AI discourse by demonstrating how technical architecture can operationalize equity and safety principles from inception.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Copewell，一个基于多智能体群系统的人工智能心理健康支持平台，通过多源评估、情绪映射和双模态干预三大技术创新，旨在为全球心理健康服务缺口提供可及、公平且安全的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 全球近10亿人受心理健康障碍影响，但中低收入国家75%的患者无法获得治疗，原因包括劳动力短缺、成本障碍和污名化。现有的AI健康解决方案主要依赖单一模式对话界面，存在高弃用率且无法根据用户动态情绪状态提供可测量的即时缓解。
AI.method: 提出Copewell多智能体群系统，包含三大技术创新：(1) 多源评估框架，整合自我报告、生理和情境数据以减轻算法偏差；(2) 基于Russell情感环状模型的价值-唤醒情绪映射，将用户路由至专门AI智能体；(3) 双模式干预交付，结合对话支持与循证感官健康协议。同时包含隐私优先架构、专用伦理监督智能体，以及由心理健康从业者参与的设计流程。
AI.result: 通过早期从业者参与和Beta部署，验证了设计决策，并识别了未来实证评估的方向。
AI.conclusion: Copewell通过技术架构从设计之初就贯彻公平与安全原则，为负责任AI在心理健康领域的应用提供了示范，有助于缩小全球心理健康服务差距。

title: ComplexMimic: Human-Scene Interaction Imitation in Complex 3D Environments
summary: Physics-based Human-Scene Interaction (HSI) imitation learning is crucial for embodied intelligence as it bridges the gap between kinematic 3D motions and real-world dynamics. However, most existing methods focus on simplified scene settings, leaving complex environments largely unexplored, which limits their applicability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we focus on HSI mimicry in complex environments. Under this complex setting, we observe an inherent trade-off between successfully performing interaction and maintaining natural, physically plausible motions. To address this challenge, we propose ComplexMimic, a framework that reconstructs diverse HSI by interpreting imperfect MoCap data. First, we introduce a Dual Flow Strategy, which learns two complementary experts: an imitation expert for accurate motion tracking and an interaction expert for collision-aware adaptation in complex scenes. Second, naive multi-expert distillation, which treats all experts equally, often under-samples challenging behaviors, limiting effective learning. To mitigate this issue, we propose a difficulty-aware distillation strategy that adaptively weights supervision and prioritizes hard-yet-learnable trajectories guided by failure statistics and learning progress signals. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms current state-of-the-art methods. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/LuPan23/ComplexMimic.

AI.tldr: 提出ComplexMimic框架，通过双流策略和难例感知蒸馏，在复杂环境下实现物理真实的人-场景交互模仿学习，超越当前SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有HSI模仿学习方法多聚焦于简化场景，难以处理复杂环境中的交互与物理合理性之间的权衡问题。
AI.method: 1) 双流策略：模仿专家（精确动作跟踪）+ 交互专家（碰撞感知适应）；2) 难例感知蒸馏：基于失败统计和学习进度自适应加权，优先学习困难但可学的轨迹。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，ComplexMimic显著优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出有效解决复杂环境HSI中交互成功与物理自然性之间权衡的框架，为具身智能在真实场景中的应用提供了可行方案。

title: Online Safety Monitoring for LLMs
summary: Despite alignment training, LLMs remain prone to generating unsafe outputs at deployment time. Monitoring outputs online and raising an alarm when safety can no longer be assumed is therefore critical.
